subject.title: [Feature]: Chat should surface still-running background tasks after the turn ends

question: Should Control UI adopt the linked PR's persistent in-thread status row for background work after a foreground turn settles?
rationale: The underlying task state already exists; the unresolved choice is whether this additional chat presentation should become a maintained product surface.

options.title: Adopt the status row
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106115 after confirming the visual treatment and lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Keep rail-only visibility
options.body: Close the implementation direction and retain the existing tasks rail and toggle badge as the sole persistent indicators.

options.title: Request another treatment
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a less persistent or differently positioned background-work indicator.

recommendation.title: Adopt the status row
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106115 after confirming the visual treatment and lifecycle behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed both the product behavior and its concrete Control UI implementation.
